staticText: Private quote-based boarding-school full-cost planner using explicit per-term tuition, boarding, meals and levies; monthly pocket and supplies periods; transport trips; annual charges; one-time setup; duration; optional compounding inflation; contingency; and an optional user-entered day-school comparison. It provides a year schedule and formula multipliers but no country or school-type averages, value ranking, academic-outcome claim or fee quote.
